verdict.rationale: Simular documents a progress event stream (GET /v1/agents/events), live watching of its computers ('Nothing in the blackbox'), and saving a run as a replayable skill, which implies the steps are captured. All of this is live or reusable-script oriented rather than a stored per-run review record. missing for 10: documented after-the-fact run history or replay, recorded screenshots or video of the screens seen, a log of injected keyboard/mouse inputs, retention and access details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, every run is reviewable afterwards: the steps taken, the screens seen, and the inputs injected

citations.quote: Watch your Sai computers work. Nothing in the blackbox. Sit back and enjoy full transparency.
Save this as a replayable skill named invoice_export, with vendor and month as parameters.
